title: El Gato Prime: acid-lime kinetic title sting (Higgsfield x Claude x After Effects demo)
summary: Square split-screen: top ~55% is a 15 s punk/streetwear kinetic title sting for 'EL GATO PRIME' (cat-eye icon, running cartoon cat, crown); bottom shows the After Effects timeline and a Claude chat that built it. The sting slams single words onto full-bleed flat colour fields (violet, acid lime, cream) with 3D extruded heavy type, torn-paper wipes, a starburst and a diagonal repeating-text band, landing on a lockup 'EL GATO / PRIME / REY DE LA NOCHE'.
fit_reason: Great energy and a reusable word-slam grammar, but the punk/streetwear look and cartoon mascot clash with a calm premium B2B voice.

palette.mood: high-contrast acid lime on deep violet-black, risograph grain

typography.display: condensed ultra-heavy grotesk (Anton/Druk-like) with a hard 3D extrude/drop in violet; small tracked-out caps for sublines ('E L  G A T O', 'R E Y  D E  L A  N O C H E'); outline (stroke-only) duplicate words behind solids
typography.size_behaviour: huge, fills 60-90% of frame width, often tilted 5-10 degrees
typography.notes: Corner bug 'HIGGSFIELD / CLAUDE OPUS 5.5' as black-on-lime italic label stickers top right throughout.

text_animation: one word per beat hard-slammed in on its own colour field (EL / GATO / PRIME)
letters reveal by vertical wipe (PRIM -> PRIME)
outline-text row scrolling horizontally behind solid word
diagonal band of repeating 'EL GATO PRIME —' text scrolling
final word scale-punch with slight rotation settle
motion: cat sprite runs across frame with motion-smear ghost copies
ui_treatment: none in the sting; the bottom half shows real After Effects + Claude UI as proof of process

pacing.hold_time_s: 0.1-0.6 per word slam, 2-3 s final lockup

sound.sync: word slams and colour flashes land on beats

signature_moves: one-word-per-beat slams on alternating flat lime/violet fields
diagonal repeating-text band before the final lockup

best_segments.what: violet -> lime 'EL' -> 'GATO' slams, running cat, diagonal text band, then PRIME lockup lands

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion: full-bleed colour divs swapped on beat grid, Anton-style font with text-shadow stack for extrude, SVG torn-edge mask wipe, CSS grain overlay, marquee band rotated -12deg.
recreate.prompt: Kinetic title sting, deep violet-black #110622 and acid lime #CDFE3D, one condensed ultra-heavy word per beat slammed on flat colour fields, 3D violet extrude, torn-paper wipes, riso grain, diagonal repeating text band, final centred lockup.
